Ongoing Investigations & Unfinished Business

Jötunheimr Tasks

  • Investigate “Jonny”; why did Mordred get mistaken for him?
  • Find out about the floods. Is Jötunheimr suffering from climate change? What could the cause me? Ask expects.
  • Why do smiths who acquire a noticeable level of skill disappear?
  • Find suitable agents to run the Jötunheimr side of the mead trade route.
  • Why are the giants happier and the people less oppressed? Not that it is a bad thing, but knowing the cause could be useful.

People

Artie

See fig. 1

Alias

  • Beari, Captain Aurtoro

Head of SATT’s Section 13. Reincarnation of King Arthur. Scion of Britannia. Wielder of Gram, which fits his hand like an extension of his own body and is able to carry it unnoticeably (although I have no idea if that is his ability or one of the sword’s). He is a highly capable swordsman and can summon a suit of amour when needed.

Reincarnation

He has resurrected multiple times over the years, each time with different names, faces, and skills.

Relationships

Has had an ongoing relationship with Freya for a long time (according to Whisper, he fell hard for the goddess when he was a scribe in the 1200s) and is the father of Berron. (I’m starting to suspect that the whole thing with Lancelot and Guinevere wasn’t entirely one-sided).

At SATT

Usually puts on a stutter.

Keeps a secure office some distance from Patrizia’s — down the corridor, left, left again, half way down the corridor, then the application of a gesture and verbal command to unveil the door.

The study is furnished in classic 1940s style, heavy on the leather arm chairs (which appear to be enchanted for comfort), leather bound books and pictures (mostly not leather bound). The one nod to the modern world is a high end coffee machine.

Notable pictures include:

  • A candid B&W photograph of Whisper
  • A recent photograph of Vanessa (their exact relationship isn’t known)
  • WWII flyboys
  • WWI tank crew
  • A pencil drawing of the Eternal Knight circa the 3rd crusade. He is short, broad and has wispy brown hair. The coat of arms is presented here.
  • Several of a Roman-style goddess — Britannia — one conceals a classic tumbler driver combination safe.

He was reliving Henry’s deaths in nightmares, which were related to the curse.

Mordred son of Mordred

PC: David

Aliases

  • Morty
  • Martin

Until recently has been, grudgingly, working for his father (e.g. during in the Antonovich Elimination which got General Pushkin his job). He is currently on secondment to SATT where he has an office near Alexia’s and has found himself working for his grandfather.

He has several siblings and generic testing has confirmed he shares a father (but not a mother) with Llŷr ap Leda.

Currently living with Michelle at his home in Lambeth.

His mother was (according to his father) a temple maiden but he knows nothing more of her, and was punished by his father when he asked about her. There is nothing about her recorded in the book of births, although that isn’t the case for many of his brothers.

Later he and Isis claimed she was his mother.

His actual mothers are Zana and Nephthys.

Jonny of Jötunheimr is his twin.

He bears Kladenets (but is not sure why his father gave it to him) and Brainbiter (after drawing it from SATT’s keystone).

See the Pendragon Family for details of his siblings although, of them, he only really gets along with Happy and Metty now he knows her true nature.

He feels a certain kinship to Mark via shared parental issues and has started to take the young scion under his wing.

He was trained in piloting by Charles Nungesser.

Known associates include:

  • Benny
  • Dr. Richard Mayweather
  • Michelle Devereaux
  • Seb
  • Jeremy Brand

Mordred’s office at SATT is a standard SATT office across the corridor from Alexia’s into which he has put some nicer furniture (with leanings towards mahogany and leather). There’s a whiteboard positioned where it cannot be seen from the window, vaguely sensitive documents are locked away when he isn’t there, and really sensitive documents are destroyed.

He keeps a couple of books in a drawer — The Prince (which he finds a useful reminder of his father’s state of mind) and the Merchant of Venice (which resonates with him) — and his work laptop gets dropped on top of them and locked away at night.

He keeps a deactivated pistol the used to belong to a mobster as a reminder of lessons learned during an early mission. It used to live inside a puzzle box before it was moved for security reasons.

Sometimes copies of academic papers he is working can be found there.

There are a few bottles of alcohol locked away in various drawers, but most are used for bribing people (such as Jerry). The bottle of mead in his desk drawer is the exception.

He claims to have woken up in the Paris catacombs after one night of particularly heavy drinking. This is true, and as a consequence he is an associate member of Société du Cinéma Secrètement Parisien.

He is the subject of a prophecy about swords by Roxanne.

A member of White’s.

An alias that Mordred used to get a S.I.A. Private Investigator business licence. He finds it useful to get access to a range of contacts and launder money when he is doing work funded by his father.

It is watched over by Ziczzisisieieistsi, the ice elemental.

During WWII an unexploded bomb exploded there under Henry’s watch.

Before the church was built, it was royal land.

Sam

A Titan spawn known as Sam. Sam is incredibly well respected among the Titans. His Patron is Hyperion (treats him with respect and he has been given many gifts during his very long life.).

SATT’s first recorded interaction with him was in 520 AD leading a fighting force in what is now Germany.

Likes honey cake, fine wines and Indian food. Dislikes daffodils raspberry and orange.

Sam lives at a villa in the south of France. It is built using modern materials and techniques but in the Roman style. It is decorated with images of Lancelot du Lac, Guinevere, Arthur and Roman Senators.

He has a passion for history. The guest rooms feature old masters. The library is full of leather bound books (many about history).

The computer centre is a serious piece of work.

His training room has scorched targets but no sign of projectile weapons. There is also a suit of armour, with no livery.

At the heart of the villa is a pool featuring a mosaic of Britannia with a sundisc overlooking her.

He has a London residence at 41 Gloucester Place.

Sir. Gawain was a knight of the the Round Table.

Due to their affair, he killed Sir Lamarok and Morgawse (although the latter was secretly saved). Sir. Avalon tried to poison him in revenge.

At the final battle he threw Excalibur into the lake, then met Lancelot and got into a fight, which he lost. He cried out and was saved by the Titans who earned his loyalty.

He can probably be counted on to send aid against Ares and Ptah.

Groups

SATT

See fig. 2

Alias

  • Scions Against Titan Terrorism (among the Gods)
  • Special Agency Terrorism Taskforce (among Mortals)

An organisation that deals with supernatural threats. Has semi-official government recognition within the UK (at least).

History

It has been around, in one form or another, since the 400s.

Camelot for the original version. Camlann saw an end to that.

After that battle, the Gods wanted something to prevent wars. Most of them thought the idea was too impractical but a few decided to try anyway.

William Adrihll (a scion of Britannia) took the lead in the 600s. He pulled together a force of scions to make a difference. The oath was witnessed by Hecate and Britannia.

Then Lady Margaret Swinmor after that one was destroyed. Artie involved himself again in the 1320s.

Options

Agencies, monsters, gods and other realms tend to hate SATT. They are seen as “interfering busybodies that come from Britain to bugger up their lives” (rather like the CIA). Add to that that they were founded by a reincarnation of King Arthur back in the 600AD and they are not popular. The other gods can see them as the goddess Britannica’s police force and army and have worked together to systematically kill agents or shut them down in the past.

Keystone

Artefacts

Heb-Sed Mace

See fig. 3

A mace depicting Narmer’s Heb-Sed. It may be the first depiction of the ceremony in history and seems likely to be be the missing artefact needed to perform the special Heb-Sed festival.

It was on public display at the Ashmolean before it was stolen by unknown thieves and then liberated from them to SATT by Mordred, Berron, and Greg.

It has since been “returned”, but since the original is safely locked up at SATT, this is a copy. The source is unknown and warrants further investigation.

Was-sceptre

See fig. 4

Symbol of power, authority and dominion. It appears as a stylized animal head at the top of a long, straight staff with a forked end.

One found in Vanessa’s office has gods names in hieroglyphs all over it but unfilled areas too.

Events

Gawain in London

Mar 2023

I filled Sam in about the situation and drove him to his London home.

The treaty seems to be holding; everyone is behaving. Themis and Theia are arguing for peace. Chronos is, unsurprisingly, against it. Apep is keeping quiet.

He wants to meet Artie, but is nervous about it. He, Grandfather and Whisper are a right trio. A millennium of avoiding each other because they might find out they’ve fallen out.

Boston, Lincolnshire

Mar 2023

Henry has been off trying to lure Section 1 into attacking him. It didn’t work. He did, however, make contact with someone calling themselves Agent K.

They claim to work for the crown and think that Asclepius’ presence in the UK should be eliminated.

It seems that John Dee made a prophecy that Henry would help the monarchy with a medical (that was the term used, despite it being anachronistic) matter. That tracks with eliminating Asclepius.

K also left him a note saying that Ironwood was amassing forces. That does not sound good.

Meanwhile at SATT Colin the cactus hasn’t been tracked down by the new management yet, and Watson has been autopsying one of Ironwood’s goons who has been stabbed by a 6–8″ dagger.

With a convoy of goods heading north, we decided to take a much overdue trip to Boston to investigate the warehouse there.

It wasn’t shy about advertising its ownership as being Asclepius. The local weren’t too happy with it; the workforce there weren’t mixing with them so they didn’t have a lot to tell us though. Security was high, but there was a possible blind spot in the camera ring.

Remy scouted the area and we got a general idea of the layout.

Later, undercover of darkness I went in. Slipping past the cameras I made my want into the security office, hooked a phone up to a PC so that Maggie could get access to their network — which was nicely air gapped before I got involved — stole a security jacket and went to explore.

The paper files didn’t turn up anything too interesting, but the research section was a bazaar of horrors. They had numerous samples of blood and other liquids, to which I helped myself so Ophelia could do an analysis later on, a coffin-like injection machine (which I sabotaged), and a disturbing number of caged rabbits (which I freed after spray-painting PETA on the wall).

Analysis

Among the contents of the vials were blood (human, Scion, and Nāga) and a modified version of the Hyde Formula.

Making sure that the phone I’d hooked up was neatly hidden inside the cable tidy at the back of the security desk, I made my exit.

Meanwhile, Maggie had been tracking the SATT convoy. It had bypassed Boston and was making its way towards the Peak District — and her library.

We portaled out way there sharpish.

Henry talked them out of attacking the library. He had to, the rest of us have too many Titan associations for it to fly. It was a close thing though.

I ran some tests of father’s ring. It doesn’t seem to have any magic associated with it, so I think it is safe.

Shadow Hide

You can hide unnoticed in any area of shadow big enough to hide your body. Someone with super hearing or smell will be able to make a contested roll to know that you are there.

The Kladenets, Sword of Darkness

You can use the sword to cast an area of darkness. This can work in conjunction with your shadow hide.

Blessing

Takes time to prepare. Target (which can be self) rolls 3d6k2 instead of 2d6 until the blessing expires. Level affects range.

Create Ice

Creates ice out of moisture in the air. Effectiveness varies with the weather conditions.
